latest.description: The latest available version of the app (e.g., '0.2').

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system.

name.description: User's display name or nickname. This is not unique.

username.description: User's unique handle, starting with '@'. This must be unique across all users.

avatar.description: URL to the user's avatar image.

statusMessage.description: A short status message from the user.

hasSetNickname.description: True if the user has set their nickname at least once.

isBot.description: True if the user is a bot account.

isDeleted.description: True if the user account has been deleted/anonymized.

lastSeen.description: Server timestamp of when the user was last active.

Username.title: Username
Username.description: Maps a unique username to a user ID to enforce uniqueness.

uid.description: The user ID associated with this username.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: A single message within a chat.

senderId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

content.description: The text content of the message.

imageUrl.description: URL to an image attachment, in Base64 data URI format.

timestamp.description: The server timestamp when the message was created.

editedAt.description: The server timestamp when the message was last edited.

type.description: The type of message. 'user' is a standard message, 'announcement' is a system message styled as from a bot.

senderName.description: Display name of the sender, used for bot messages.

senderAvatar.description: Avatar URL of the sender, used for bot messages.

readBy.description: List of user IDs who have read the message.

replyTo.description: Information about the message being replied to.

VideoChunk.title: Video Chunk
VideoChunk.description: A single chunk of a video file, stored separately to avoid document size limits.

data.description: Base64 encoded data of the video chunk.

part.description: The order of this chunk in the video sequence.

messageId.description: The ID of the message this chunk belongs to.

chatId.description: The ID of the chat this chunk belongs to (for security rules).

senderId.description: The ID of the user who sent this chunk.

name.description: Name of the group or channel.

members.description: List of user IDs who are members of this chat.

ownerId.description: The user ID of the owner of the group or channel.

icon.description: Name of the lucide-react icon for the chat.

avatar.description: URL to the chat's avatar image, in Base64 data URI format.

lastMessage.description: The last message sent in the chat for display in the sidebar.

unreadCounts.description: Map of user IDs to their unread message count for this chat.

link.description: Unique link for a group or channel.

discussionChatId.description: The ID of the group chat linked to this channel for discussions.

ChatLink.title: Chat Link
ChatLink.description: Maps a unique chat link to a chat ID to enforce uniqueness.

chatId.description: The chat ID associated with this link.

BotLink.title: Bot Link
BotLink.description: Maps a unique bot link to a user ID to enforce uniqueness.

botId.description: The user ID of the bot associated with this link.

/config/version.description: Stores global application configuration like the latest version.

/chats/{chatId}.description: Stores metadata for chat rooms (DMs, groups, channels).

/chats/{chatId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Stores messages for a specific chat.

/chatLinks/{linkId}.description: Used to enforce unique links for groups and channels.

/botLinks/{linkId}.description: Used to enforce unique links for bots.

/videoChunks/{chunkId}.description: Stores individual chunks of uploaded video files.
